tools.name: check_ssl
tools.description: Checks the HTTPS setup of a public website in a few seconds: TLS certificate (issuer, expiry, trust, name), negotiated TLS version, redirect from HTTP to HTTPS and security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy). tools.name: search_cyber_knowledge
tools.description: Searches the free KrakenShield Knowledge Center: cybersecurity glossary, acronyms, security certifications (CISSP, OSCP, ISO 27001...) and the "Cyber from A to Z" guide. Returns short passages with the URL of each page to cite. Use a few precise keywords.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current prices of KrakenShield: cost of each audit (SSL/TLS and surface, privacy, code analysis, penetration test) and of KrakenShield Cybersecurity Awareness training and certification in Kredits, and the price of Kredit packs in euros excluding VAT.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current prices of KrakenShield: cost of each audit (SSL/TLS and surface, privacy, code analysis, penetration test) and of Cyber Academy training in Kredits, and the price of Kredit packs in euros excluding VAT." → after: "Current prices of KrakenShield: cost of each audit (SSL/TLS and surface, privacy, code analysis, penetration test) and of KrakenShield Cybersecurity Awareness training and certification in Kredits, and the price of Kredit packs in euros excluding VAT."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
